addition.item: Added category-based control for AI metadata generation.
Added an option to exclude selected Joomla content categories from automatic meta description and meta keywords generation.
Added an option to run AI metadata generation only on selected Joomla content categories.

change.item: Improved plugin configuration by giving site owners more control over where AI metadata generation is applied.
Kept the default behavior unchanged by running on all categories unless a category rule is configured.

language.item: Added English administrator language strings for category rule options.
Added Turkish administrator language strings for category rule options.

note.item: This release is especially useful for news portals, editorial websites, obituary sections, and websites with different content workflows.
Use Exclude selected categories to prevent AI metadata generation in sensitive or manually managed content sections.
Use Run only on selected categories when AI metadata generation should be limited to specific Joomla categories.

addition.item: Added a clearer Output Language field label and description.
Added improved Custom Language / Locale guidance for multilingual websites.
Added helpful custom language examples such as Serbian Latin, Brazilian Portuguese, Swiss German, and Croatian formal.

change.item: Improved the language selection user experience in the plugin configuration.
Clarified the difference between predefined output languages and custom language or locale input.
Updated project wording to better reflect the Simple. Clean. Lightweight. Functional. direction of the extension.

language.item: Updated English and Turkish system language descriptions.

fix.item: Fixed a small custom language handling issue related to trim().

note.item: This release improves the multilingual configuration experience while keeping JT AI SEO Assistant simple, clean, lightweight, and functional.
For languages or regional variants not listed in the predefined options, choose Custom Language / Locale and enter the preferred language style manually.
This is another small but important step toward the stable 1.0 release.

addition.item: Added automatic metadata language mode to keep output in the same language as the article content.
Added custom metadata language option for multilingual websites.

change.item: Improved prompt instructions to reduce mixed-language output in meta descriptions and keywords.
Updated language handling so non-Turkish content no longer falls back to English by default.
Improved support for Joomla 6 multilingual editorial workflows.

fix.item: Fixed an issue where Croatian articles could generate mostly English meta descriptions.
Fixed an issue where generated keywords could be mixed between Croatian and English.
Fixed language handling behavior for non-English and non-Turkish article content.

note.item: For Croatian websites, set Metadata language to Croatian or Automatic - same as article content.
For multilingual websites, the Automatic - same as article content option is recommended.
This is still an early 0.x release, but it includes an important improvement for real-world multilingual publishing workflows.

addition.item: Added update server support to the plugin manifest.
Added changelog URL support to the plugin manifest.
Added a GPL-compatible license header to the main plugin class.

change.item: Improved Turkish administrator translations for the API key field and About tab.
Renamed the basic settings fieldset label to Plugin Settings.

note.item: Update the GitHub URLs if you use a different repository name or release path.
The checksum values in update.xml match the ZIP package generated for version 0.1.6.

addition.item: Added a new About fieldset to the plugin configuration.
Added usage notes and support information to the plugin settings screen.
